salesforce:query.doc:name: Query by request id
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, Request_ID__c, Ticket_Status__c, Priority__c, Assigned_Team__c, Customer_Tier__c, Acknowledgement_Due_At__c, Resolution_Due_At__c, CreatedDate FROM Support_Ticket__c WHERE Request_ID__c = ':requestId' LIMIT 1

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toContract from dwl::TicketMapper input payload application/java output application/java --- if (isEmpty(payload)) null else toContract(payload[0])

%dw 2.0 import toSalesforce from dwl::StatusMap output application/java var t = vars.ticketToSave --- [ { Subject__c: t.subject, Description__c: t.description, Category_Code__c: t.categoryCode, Product_Code__c: t.productCode, Customer_ID__c: t.customerId, Customer_Tier__c: t.customerTier default "STANDARD", Contact_Email__c: t.contactEmail, Contact_Channel__c: t.contactChannel, Request_ID__c: t.requestId, Stated_Severity__c: t.statedSeverity, Ticket_Status__c: toSalesforce("NEW"), Priority__c: t.priority, Assigned_Team__c: t.team, Acknowledgement_Due_At__c: if (t.ackDueAt != null) (t.ackDueAt as DateTime) else null, Resolution_Due_At__c: if (t.resolutionDueAt != null) (t.resolutionDueAt as DateTime) else null } ]

salesforce:query.doc:name: Read back by Id
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, Request_ID__c, Ticket_Status__c, Priority__c, Assigned_Team__c, Customer_Tier__c, Acknowledgement_Due_At__c, Resolution_Due_At__c, CreatedDate FROM Support_Ticket__c WHERE Id = ':id'

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toContract from dwl::TicketMapper input payload application/java output application/java --- toContract(payload[0]) ++ { matchedRuleId: vars.ticketToSave.matchedRuleId, priorityReason: vars.ticketToSave.priorityReason, targetQueue: vars.ticketToSave.targetQueue, isDefaultRoute: vars.ticketToSave.isDefaultRoute }
